Hi @haghera@nvidia.com — Per PDI Software/Version.interface.yaml, 
https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Software/Version.interface.yaml
the description recommends this interface be placed under /xyz/openbmc_project/software object path. 
Should we create a /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<id> object with a `running` association to the inventory item?
set unsolved

Done.
The latest PS publishes the an object under the path
`/xyz/openbmc_project/software/...`,
and publishes the version string there.

Could you also create this for the interface above? Could you please create an additional refactor Gerrit patch? 
Thanks!

Could you take off these two, because they are already merged.
Thanks!

can we use `inventoryPrefix + name` here?

if we pass the `inventoryPrefix + name` here, we can use it.
